CITY OF SOUTH PASADENA
  CITY COUNCIL CLOSED SESSION
  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA

  Emergency Operations Center (EOC)
  South Pasadena Fire Department
  817 Mound Avenue, South Pasadena, CA 91030

  Wednesday, May 27, 2020, at 6:00 p.m.

  NOTICE ON PUBLIC PARTICIPATION & ACCESSIBILITY

 Pursuant to Section 3 of Executive Order N-29-20, issued by Governor Newsom on
 March 17, 2020, the Special Closed Session Meeting of the City Council for May 27, 2020
 will be conducted remotely and held by video conference.

 Please be advised that pursuant to the Executive Order, and to ensure the health and safety
 of the public by limiting human contact that could spread the COVID-19 virus, the
 Emergency Operations Center will not be open for the meeting. Council Members will be
 participating remotely and will not be physically present.

 If you would like to comment on a Closed Session item, members of the public may submit
 their comments in writing for City Council consideration, by emailing them to:
 ccpubliccomment@southpasadenaca.gov. Public Comments must be received by 6 p.m.,
 Tuesday, May 26, 2020 to ensure adequate time to compile and post. Public Comment
 portion of the email is limited to 150 words. Please make sure to indicate: 1) your name; 2)
 what agenda item you are submitting public comment on, or if it is a general public comment;
 and/or 3) if you request for your public comment to be read at the meeting prior to the City
 Council recessing to Closed Session.

CALL TO ORDER:  Mayor Robert S. Joe.
ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Michael A. Cacciotti, Marina
  Khubesrian, M.D, and Richard D. Schneider, M.D; Mayor
  Pro Tem Diana Mahmud and Mayor Robert S. Joe.

  Wednesday, May 27, 2020
  Minutes of the Special Meeting of the City Council

  CALL TO ORDER

  A Special Meeting of the South Pasadena City Council was called to order by Mayor Joe on
  Wednesday, May 27, 2020, at 7: 11 p. m. The meeting was held in a virtual setting, with all
  Councilmembers attending via Zoom, and the meeting being broadcast via the Council
  Chamber, located at 1424 Mission Street, South Pasadena, California.

  A brief introduction was provide by Mayor Joe of the current protocols in place in an effort to
  prevent the spread of COVID- 19.

  ROLL CALL

  Present  via Councilmember Khubesrian, and Schneider; Mayor Pro Tem Mahmud; and Mayor
  Zoom:  Joe. Councilmember Cacciotti joined the meeting at 7: 26 p. m.

  Absent:  None

  City Staff  City Manager De Wolfe (in attendance via Zoom); City Attorney Teresa Highsmith
  Present: (  in attendance via Zoom); Fire Chef Riddle; Police Chef Joe Ortiz; and Chef City
  Clerk Ayala were present at Roll Call.

  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Mayor Robert Joe deferred the leading of the flag salute to Fire Chef Paul Riddle. Fire Chef
  Paul Riddle led the Pledge of Allegiance.

  SPECIAL PRESENTATION

  1.  Briefing by Assemblymember Holden on State Efforts in Response to COVID- 19
  Pandemic

  Mayor Joe introduced Assemblymember Chris Holden.

  Page 1 of 3
 DocuSign Envelope ID: F36DFBE2- 8BAA- 469C- A18B- C528D57519EE

  Assemblymember Holden, Representing California's 41st Assembly District (in attendance
  via Zoom) provided an update on various State efforts in response to the COVID- 19
  pandemic.

  City Council had questions and comments for Assemblymember Holden regarding:
  Caltrans owned homes; environmentally conscious recovery strategies; shifting from
  traditional work schedules towards working remotely; a deadline extension for City
  Housing Element submittal; restaurant third party delivery service fee caps; State
  preparedness for a second COVID- 19 surge; State support for contact tracing; etc.

  Assemblymember Holden responded to City Council' s  questions  and  comments
  accordingly and provided additional information.

  Chief City Clerk Ayala announced a public comment was submitted after public comment
  deadline, thanking Assemblymember Holden for his work for the City of South Pasadena.
  The public comment would be uploaded to Additional Documents for the meeting.

  PRESENTATION

  2.  South Pasadena COVID- 19 Update

  Fire Chief Riddle provided a PowerPoint presentation with a general report of the City and
  update on the Fire Department; Police Chief Ortiz provided a verbal update on the Police

  Department; and City Manager DeWolfe provided a PowerPoint presentation regarding the
  Los Angeles County restrictions on businesses, worship services, outdoor recreational
  facilities, Library services, reopening of City Hall, etc.

  City Council had comments and questions regarding: locations in the City residents can
  obtain face masks; ACE Hardware' s social distancing strategies; the City' s plastic bag ban;
  the City' s overnight parking; Neighboring City' s overnight parking protections; speeding
  vehicles and traffic concerns; domestic violence outreach; requirements on wearing face
  mask; the Los Angeles County variance application; future allowance of virtual meetings;
  City Hall reopening date; etc.

  Chief City Clerk Ayala announced the public comment received and read it aloud.

  Public Comment:

  W. Rodriguez — Asked questions regarding the submittal of petitions to the State
  regarding reopening restrictions and strategies.
